_: Soda-lime-silica glass (window / float / bottle glass, ~72 % SiO2, 14 % Na2O, 9 % CaO); annealed. Room temperature, clean annealed glass unless a state says otherwise. Solids research lane 11-07 (the project's materials research note SOLIDS.md).

alpha.src: fire-polished / float surface Ra ~0.2-1 nm: optically smooth; 0.005 keeps the highlight finite

n.src: SCHOTT_B270 nd 1.5230 (a soda-lime crown); float glass 1.51-1.53

n_d.src: SCHOTT_B270 nd 1.5230 (a soda-lime crown); float glass 1.51-1.53

absorption.v: clear in the visible; soda-lime float shows a green edge tint (Fe2+ ~0.1 % Fe2O3) and blocks UVB; borosilicate and fused silica water-clear (fused silica transmits deep UV)

translucency.v: transparent (no volume scattering); thickness tint only

static.src: ETB glass on glass clean 0.9-1.0, lubricated 0.1-0.6; contaminated (skin oil, airborne hydrocarbons) E 0.3-0.6

kinetic.src: ETB: E: recalled from ETB, not re-read (was M); ETB / CRC tables glass on glass kinetic 0.4 (recalled from the source, not re-read 11-07); wet E

friction.counterface: glass on glass (pair table holds skin, wood)

surface_energy_mJ_m2.src: WETTING: clean silicate glass is a high-energy surface (water spreads); air contamination drops the effective energy fast; E: recalled from WETTING, not re-read

wringing.v: two optically flat clean glass faces pressed together 'wring' (optical contact): van der Waals + hydrogen bonding, can hold > 1 bar equivalent and need sliding to separate; a thin water film between flat plates holds by capillary suction (Laplace pressure ~ 2 gamma / gap: ~0.15 MPa at 1 um)
wringing.src: capillary: 2 x 72 mN/m / 1 um = 0.144 MPa; wringing E from optics practice

restitution.src: FOERSTER94: E: recalled from FOERSTER94, not re-read (was M); FOERSTER94 glass spheres on glass, normal e ~0.97 (small spheres, low speed); slab glass breaks above a threshold

collision_thickness_mm.src: numerical offset only: a rigid solid has no compliant surface layer; 0.1 mm sits below what reads on screen at character distance and above the field's float/step resolution at metre scale, so contacts never show a gap or a pass-through; finishes (lacquer, sealer, a water film) are thinner still

E_star_GPa.src: E / (1 - nu^2) from E 71 GPa, nu 0.22 (the half-space modulus; a rigid indenter assumed, the soft partner's own E* combines in series)

contact_stiffness_kPa_per_mm.src: mean pressure per mm of overlap under a 50 mm-radius flat patch (hand-sized): k = 2 E* a (flat punch), / (pi a^2): ~1e5-1e6 kPa/mm, so the solver should treat the surface as an unyielding barrier and let the soft partner deform

hertz_constant_N_per_m1_5_R25mm.src: F = (4/3) E* sqrt(R) d^1.5 for a rigid sphere R 25 mm

contact_damping_ratio.src: zeta = -ln e / sqrt(pi^2 + ln^2 e) from restitution 0.95

restitution.src: FOERSTER94: E: recalled from FOERSTER94, not re-read (was M); FOERSTER94 glass spheres e ~0.97

response_time_ms.src: Hertz contact time t = 2.87 (m^2 / (R E*^2 v))^0.2 for a rigid 1 kg sphere, R 25 mm, 1 m/s on this material: tens of microseconds. In a hand slap the soft tissue sets the pulse (ms); this surface only has to not yield, so the slap's sound and stop come from the hand

damping_ratio.src: as contact_damping_ratio (energy lost per impact, from restitution)

solver._: Rigid until it breaks: a pane hit hard enough fails at the flaw-controlled strength in deform.fracture (the contact pulse then ends early).

water_contact_angle_deg.src: WETTING: E: recalled from WETTING, not re-read (was M); WETTING: clean < 10 (film), air-aged 20-50; silane/rain-repellent coatings 95-115 E

wetting._: Whether glass fogs (droplets) or stays clear (a film) is set by this angle: clean / anti-fog hydrophilic glass condenses to a clear film; ordinary contaminated glass fogs into droplets.

water_absorption.src: none (only a nm hydrated surface layer)

v.position: positive: charges + against most polymers (acrylic -10, PET -40, PTFE -190), wool, cotton, wood; dry skin (+30) and nylon sit slightly higher

resistivity_ohm_m.src: GLASSREF soda-lime volume resistivity ~1e10 ohm m at room temperature (ionic Na+ conduction); E: recalled from GLASSREF, not re-read

surface_resistivity_ohm_sq.src: glass surface conduction through an adsorbed water film; strongly humidity dependent (electrostatics practice)

hardness.src: SCHOTT_B270: E: recalled from SCHOTT_B270, not re-read (was M); SCHOTT_B270 HK0.1/20 500; Vickers and Mohs GLASSREF (recalled from the source, not re-read 11-07)

abrasion.v: scratched by quartz sand (Mohs 7) in grit: hazes over years in windscreens and floors; frosting is deliberate abrasion or HF etching

density_kg_m3.src: float: E: recalled from float, not re-read (was M); float glass 2500 kg/m3 (EN 572-1 (recalled from the source, not re-read 11-07)); SCHOTT_B270 2550

toughness_KIC_MPa_m05.src: GLASSREF soda-lime K_IC 0.72-0.82; E: recalled from GLASSREF, not re-read

strength_tensile_MPa.src: GLASSREF: strength is set by surface flaws, not the bulk (characteristic bending strength of annealed float 45 MPa in EN 572-1); fully tempered 120-200 MPa; E: recalled from GLASSREF, not re-read

critical_flaw_um_at_50MPa.src: a = (K_IC / (1.12 sigma sqrt(pi)))^2: the edge-crack depth that fails at 50 MPa

fracture._: Elastic to fracture, no plasticity at room temperature; cracks run at up to ~1500 m/s; failure statistics are Weibull (size and surface condition).

thermal_expansion_1_K.src: GLASSREF soda-lime 8.5-9.5e-6/K; E: recalled from GLASSREF, not re-read

thermal_shock_dT_K.src: R = sigma_f (1 - nu) / (E alpha) with sigma_f 50 MPa: temperature jump a plate survives (borosilicate / silica far higher than soda-lime)

conductivity_W_mK.src: GLASSREF float glass ~1.0 W/mK (EN 572-1 (recalled from the source, not re-read 11-07))

heat_capacity_J_kgK.src: GLASSREF ~720-840 J/kgK (EN 572-1 720); E: recalled from GLASSREF, not re-read

effusivity.src: sqrt(k rho c) = sqrt(1.0 x 2500 x 840) W s^0.5 m^-2 K^-1

contact_temp_with_skin_C.src: SKINTH: T = (e_skin 33 + e 20)/(e_skin + e), skin 33 C on material 20 C, e_skin = 1188 (sqrt(0.37 x 1090 x 3500)); lower = feels colder

emissivity.src: glass emissivity ~0.92-0.95 in the thermal IR (opaque there)

fogged.src: condensed droplets 1-20 um on a contaminated (20-50 deg) surface scatter light out of the view: the look is a white haze; model as a droplet layer rather than roughness when the renderer can

wet.src: a water film on glass: optically a second interface (n 1.333); glass-glass friction drops (ETB lubricated 0.1-0.6) but flat plates stick by capillarity

frosted_etched.src: acid-etched Ra ~0.5-2 um (satin, translucent, diffuse transmission); sandblasted Ra 2-6 um, alpha ~0.5-0.7 and whiter

smudged.src: skin sebum fingerprints (oil.sebum) leave a hydrophobic patterned film that scatters a little

tempered.src: GLASSREF: surface compression ~ 90-150 MPa; breaks into small cubes ('dice') instead of shards
